premise: I drained the $128,000 nursing pension I earned over thirty-two years of night shifts to open an antiquarian book-and-paper conservation studio with my son, notarizing a 50% stake and a lifetime of free Bible repairs for my church’s Sunday school, but after a university rare-book library offered $740,000 for the restored first-folio collection he forged a dissolution, sold the inventory, and handed me a $4,600 'colophon' check; I found our original agreement hidden inside the hollowed board of an 18th-century Geneva Bible, voided the sale, and now run 'Binding of Deceit Rare Books,' where he sews book signatures in a canvas apron that says 'Stitched in Lies' and every restoration certificate prints his fraud-docket number.
